hero.title: Hotel bedding and bath, cut for the room.
hero.description: Sheet sets, towels and curtains for hotels and retail. Embroidery and OEKO-TEX lots when the order asks for them.
hero.imageAlt: Hotel bedding program with layered linen

audiences.title: Who buys these linens.
audiences.description: A hotel reorders the same SKU for years. A retailer changes a colour each season. A developer needs the room to match.

items.title: Hotels
items.description: Guestroom sets and embroidered bath, with a call-off quantity for replenishment.

items.title: Retailers
items.description: Bedding collections and terry in a colour story, packed for shelf or gift box.

items.title: Developers
items.description: One room type: matched sheeting, curtains and bath SKUs.

items.title: Product developers
items.description: A set you can put on a bed, plus an embroidery proof on the actual terry.

capabilities.title: Sheeting, terry, stitch, pack.
capabilities.description: Thread count, GSM and stitch density are set per SKU before the first bulk lot.

items.title: Bedding
items.description: Sets, duvets and pillows — thread count and size written on the SKU card.

items.title: Bath terry
items.description: Hospitality and retail palettes. GSM confirmed on the towel, not the quote.

items.title: Embroidery
items.description: Logo size, thread and placement signed on a proof before the heads run.

items.title: Set packing
items.description: Cartons labelled by room or colourway, with a piece count on the list.

process.title: From a room list to packed sets.
process.description: The slow part is agreeing GSM, size and logo. Bulk starts when those three are signed.

steps.title: Send the room list
steps.description: Product, size, GSM, colour, embroidery and quantity.

steps.title: Pick the workshop
steps.description: Sheeting, terry or curtain line, by finish and volume.

steps.title: Approve the set
steps.description: Sample on the bed, logo on the towel.

steps.title: Make the lot
steps.description: Stitch, finish and set completeness checked on the line.

steps.title: Count and ship
steps.description: Set count, packing list and certificates in the carton.

testimonials.quote: Logo size on the terry matched the proof. Housekeeping could tell room types from the labels.
testimonials.author: Crest Hotels · Singapore

testimonials.quote: 200 GSM bath and 300TC sheeting arrived together for the soft opening.
testimonials.author: Oak & Linen Retail · UK

warranty.title: What we do when a set or certificate fails.
warranty.description: The signed sample set and the lot number are the reference.
warranty.commitment: Claims are checked against the signed set, the certificate and the packing list in the carton.

cases.question: If the certificate does not match the lot
cases.title: Hold the PO until the scope file is attached.
cases.description: OEKO-TEX claims travel with the order. Uncertified pieces stay off certified cartons.

cases.question: If embroidery misses the artwork
cases.title: Proof first, then the heads.
cases.description: Size, thread and placement are signed on the proof. Off-spec pieces are pulled before packing.

cases.question: If a set is incomplete
cases.title: The packing list is the count.
cases.description: Each set is counted at final audit. Shortage claims follow that list.

ecosystem.title: Sheeting, terry and curtain workshops.
ecosystem.description: Mills we already run: hotel sheeting, bath terry, and made-to-measure curtains.

cta.title: Send a room list or a reference set.
cta.description: Product, size, colour and quantity are enough. We reply with a workshop, an MOQ and a sample date.
cta.formDescription: Attach a spec sheet, a room photo or embroidery artwork.
steps: Send the room list or the set.
Get a workshop, MOQ and a sample date.
Sign the set and the logo proof before bulk packing.
